title: Baste Duterte declared hostile witness in VP Sara impeach trial
summary: The Senate impeachment court on Tuesday declared Davao City Mayor Sebastian 'Baste' Duterte as a 'hostile witness' in the trial of his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte.
